purpose: Provenance for the FGF8-graded moving-boundary 3D wing bud model added in Pass 3 of 1979-newman-limb-chondrogenesis-turing.py (Section 4b). Every numeric default of FGF8_GROWTH_DEFAULTS is traced here to a source or flagged as a model assumption.
organism: Gallus gallus (chick wing bud, Hamburger-Hamilton stages 20-27)

hyaluronidase_clock.law: lambda_F(t) = lambda_0 exp(-t / tau_H); L_PD(t) = lambda_F(t) ln(F_ap / F_thr)
hyaluronidase_clock.stage_timing_source: Hamburger & Hamilton (1951) J. Morphol. 88:49-92: HH20 ~ 3.5 d, HH24 ~ 4.5 d, HH27 ~ 5.5 d of incubation (~24 h between the Table 1 wing stages)
hyaluronidase_clock.fit_method: least squares of ln(L_PD(0)/L_PD(t)) on t through the origin (one free parameter tau_H)
hyaluronidase_clock.mechanistic_basis: Toole (1972) Dev. Biol. 29:321-329 (hyaluronate removal precedes chondrogenesis); Newman & Frisch (1979) p. 664-665 (hyaluronidase-driven decrease of effective diffusivity shrinks the uncondensed zone). The exponential is a FIT, not derived from enzyme kinetics (Pass 4 item).

fgf8_gradient_and_thresholds.profile: F(z, t) = F_AER(t) exp(-(L(t) - z) / lambda_F(t)) (quasi-steady diffusion-degradation from the AER)

F_apical.meaning: FGF8 fraction above which distal mesenchyme stays undifferentiated / refractory to condensation (Dirichlet u = v = 0 boundary of the active zone)
F_apical.source: model assumption calibrated so that L_PD = lambda_F ln 5; FGF8 keeps distal mesenchyme undifferentiated: Sun, Mariani & Martin (2002) Nature 418:501-508

F_thr.meaning: FGF8 fraction below which tissue exits the progress zone and the pattern is frozen into the record
F_thr.source: model assumption; three-zone structure after Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 and Zhu et al. (2010) PLoS ONE 5:e10892

fgf8_gradient_and_thresholds.progress_zone_depth_identity: L_PD = lambda_F (ln F_ap - ln F_thr) for any F_AER (Lean Theorem 5)

S_max_per_h.derivation: ln 2 / 12 h: ~12 h mesenchymal cell cycle in the distal wing bud
S_max_per_h.source: Summerbell & Wolpert (1972) Nature New Biol. 239:24-26 (cell-cycle time in the chick limb bud); Boehm et al. (2010) PLoS Biol. 8:e1000420 (measured proliferation rates are insufficient alone to shape the bud -> treated here as a ceiling, not a shape generator)

K_F.source: model assumption (half-maximal response inside the active zone)

proliferation.outgrowth_kinematics: tissue velocity a(z) = integral_0^z S dz'; tip velocity v_tip = a(L); Lagrangian P1 nodes advected with a(z); dilution -S u
proliferation.observed_order_of_magnitude: wing bud PD length roughly doubles between HH20 and HH27 (Summerbell 1976 J. Embryol. Exp. Morphol. 35:241-260, growth-rate maps); the model doubles 800 -> ~1410 um

L0_um.source: model assumption for the HH20 bud PD length (Summerbell 1976 gives ~0.7-0.9 mm)

L_AP_um.source: Newman & Frisch (1979) Table 1 wing AP width

L_DV_um.source: Newman & Frisch (1979) L_DV = 0.5 mm, n_DV = 1 (single dorsoventral hump)

geometry.dv_boundary: Dirichlet (DST-II): dorsal/ventral ectodermal inhibition of chondrogenesis (Solursh 1984 Cell Differ. 15:17-24)
geometry.ap_boundary: Neumann (DCT-II) with a weak anterior/posterior ectodermal inhibitory bias of range 50 um (phase selection only)

tau_FGF_h.source: model assumption for FGF8 protein clearance after AER removal (FGF bead rescue experiments imply hours-scale persistence: Niswander et al. 1993 Cell 75:579-587)

aer_excision.rule: kinetics held at their value at excision (the already-specified progress zone completes its pattern); no new positional values are generated; distal mesenchyme death after AER removal: Rowe & Fallon (1982) J. Embryol. Exp. Morphol. 68:1-7

reference_series.source: Saunders (1948) stage 18-19 AER removal -> humerus only
Summerbell (1974) J. Embryol. Exp. Morphol. 32:651-660; Summerbell, Lewis & Wolpert (1973)
normal wing: humerus + radius/ulna + digits II-IV

active_zone_kinetics.helmholtz_relation: k_c^2 = k_AP^2 + k_DV^2 + k_PD^2 (Newman & Frisch 1979 Eq. 4; Lean Theorem 4)
active_zone_kinetics.k_PD_sq: lowest eigenvalue of the discrete P1 proximodistal operator on the active-zone nodes with Dirichlet ghosts at the condensed front and at the apical boundary
active_zone_kinetics.fu_selection: bisection so that the fastest-growing linear mode q* equals m^2 + k_DV^2 + k_PD^2 with det J0 = eta * (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 / (4 D_u D_v), eta = 0.9
active_zone_kinetics.m_map_status: empirical input from Newman & Frisch Table 1 (not derived; Pass 4 item)

numerics.z: Lagrangian P1 finite elements, h0 = 8 um, bisection above h_max = 14 um, lumped mass
numerics.time: fully implicit coupled linear step (block-Thomas 2x2) + exact cubic substep, dt = 0.04 Turing units = 0.6 min
